ios.desc:
HyNote (AI Notebook) is your all-in-one AI note taker that captures, understands, and transforms everything into clear, actionable output.

From meetings and lectures to PDFs, videos, and web content—HyNote turns scattered information into structured knowledge you can instantly use.

Capture Everything 
- Record Audio & Phone Calls: Capture meetings, lectures, and calls with one tap.
- Apple Watch Notes: Record ideas instantly from your wrist, synced in real time.
- YouTube Summaries: Paste any video link and get instant summaries.
- Upload PDF & Text: Import documents and extract key insights automatically.
- Save Web Pages: Capture online articles and web content with one tap.

Understand Instantly
- AI Summaries: Get clear, concise summaries in seconds.
- Chat with ALL Your Notes: Ask anything and get answers across all your content.
- FAQ Generator: Convert notes into structured FAQs for easy review and sharing.
- SWOT Analysis: Instantly generate strategic insights from your content.
- Lecture Summary: Turn long lectures into quick, digestible summaries.

Meetings Made Easy
- Meeting Notes & Minutes: Auto-generate structured meeting summaries.
- Transcription & Speaker Identification: Convert conversations into organized, speaker-labeled notes.
- Live Translation: Translate conversations in real time,  making multilingual meetings seamless.
- Follow-Up Emails: Draft ready-to-send emails from meeting discussions.
- To-Do List & Action Items: Extract tasks and next steps automatically.

Study Smarter
- Quiz & Flashcards: Turn notes into study tools for better retention.
- Study Notes: Simplify complex materials into clear summaries.
- Study Plan: Create personalized learning plans.
- Reading Notes: Summarize books and articles into key insights and takeaways.
- Problem Solver: Break down problems step by step with AI-guided solutions.

Create & Publish
- Slides (PPT): Turn notes into presentations.
- Blog & Articles: Generate polished, publish-ready content instantly.
- Podcast: Convert notes into audio overviews and deep-dive discussions.
- Infographics: Transform information into visual summaries for quick understanding.
- Brainrot Video: Generate short, engaging videos from your notes.

Stay Organized
- Auto Tags & Folders: Organize notes effortlessly.
- Snippets: Save and reuse key pieces of content for faster workflows.
- Merge: Combine multiple notebooks into one unified workspace.

HyNote isn’t just an app; it’s your personal note-taking assistan
